title: Enroll in Apple Developer Program
description: Decide individual vs organization entity type. If org: obtain D-U-N-S number (free, 5-7 biz days). Pay $99/yr, verify ID.

title: Draft Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
description: Apple requires a public privacy policy URL before submission. Cover location data and photo storage.

title: Source QR/NFC tag supplier
description: Get quotes from 3 suppliers on unit cost MOQ and lead time for physical pet tags.

title: Decide payout entity & bank account
description: Needed for Apple tax & banking agreements later.

title: Check app name availability & trademark
description: Search App Store and USPTO basic search for the chosen name.

title: Set up GitHub org and repo structure
description: Create private repo(s) for app code, backend, and this PM dashboard.

title: Decide hosting for landing page
description: GitHub Pages vs Vercel/Netlify for the marketing site.

title: Shortlist and check domain availability
description: Check .com/.app for 3-5 name candidates, pick one.

title: Set up Google Sheet as PM database
description: Sheet + Apps Script web app powering this dashboard.

title: Set up shared Drive folder
description: Shared workspace for docs between Navid and Mehrdad.

title: Decide app backend platform
description: Auth, DB, storage, push (e.g. Firebase).

title: Competitive benchmark report
description: Animal ID, Petco Love Lost, Finding Rover, Tractive, Fi, 11pets reviewed.

title: Mine App Store/Play reviews for complaints
description: 300+ reviews across competitors, theme them.

title: Interview 10-15 pet owners + 2-3 vets/shelters
description: Validate the real gap hypotheses before building.

title: Write PRD (MVP scope + cut list)
description: One-pager defining what ships in v1.

title: Wireframe core flows
description: Onboarding, tag scan, lost mode, finder page.

title: Define brand name/logo/palette
description: Finalize name pending L5 trademark check.

title: Owner pricing & pain-point survey
description: Pair with D3 interviews; validate free-vs-paid split.

title: ASO keyword & category research
description: Shortlist App Store keywords and category.

title: Reserve social handles
description: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook group/page names.

title: Publish Privacy Policy & ToS live
description: Host on the landing page domain.

title: Complete Apple Agreements Tax & Banking
description: Required before any paid feature can go live.

title: Order sample tag batch
description: Small batch for beta testers from chosen supplier.

title: Create App Store Connect app record
description: Bundle ID, SKU, app name reservation, category.

title: Confirm data compliance scope
description: GDPR/CCPA review for location + photo data handling.

title: Stand up app backend
description: Auth, database, file storage.

title: Configure push notifications & SMS
description: APNs + Twilio (or equivalent) for scan alerts.

title: Set up CI/CD and environments
description: Staging and production pipelines.

title: Set up monitoring & analytics
description: Crash reporting and usage dashboards.

title: Provision domain and point to landing page
description: Buy domain from I3 shortlist and configure DNS.

title: Build MVP: auth + pet profile
description: Sign in with Apple, pet profile create/edit with photo.

title: Build MVP: QR/NFC tag linking + chip field
description: Tag generation, linking, AAHA lookup deep link.

title: Build MVP: lost mode + scan alerts
description: Lost toggle, flyer share, push/SMS alert inbox with map.

title: Build MVP: records, reminders, family sharing
description: Vaccine/doc storage, working reminders, multi-owner.

title: Build finder web page
description: No-login page with consent-based location share.

title: Integrate subscription paywall
description: StoreKit 2 or RevenueCat for the care tier.

title: TestFlight beta + bug fixes
description: 15-20 testers; fix top issues found.

title: Build landing page + waitlist
description: Live on the domain from I11.

title: Prepare App Store assets
description: Screenshots, preview video, listing copy.

title: Line up 5 launch partners
description: Local vets/shelters/groomers for tag distribution.

title: Draft launch content calendar
description: Reddit, IG, TikTok, FB groups for launch week.

title: Submit for App Store review
description: Submit build; respond fast to any reviewer feedback.

title: Finalize launch-volume tag order
description: Scale up supplier order based on beta demand.

title: Monitor production during launch week
description: Watch uptime, error rates, scan-alert delivery.

title: Set up data backup/export routine
description: Automated backups of user and pet data.

title: Ship approved build + hotfixes
description: Handle launch-week triage.

title: Referral loop (stretch)
description: Free tag for a friend referral flow if time allows.

title: Execute launch announcement
description: Push across Reddit, IG, TikTok, FB, partner channels.

title: Activate vet/shelter partner promos
description: Get partners posting and displaying tags.

title: Track retention & conversion
description: Day-7 retention, App Store conversion, report back.
